A stale note is NOT authorization. A cleared platform timer is NOT authorization.
re_enable_procedure: Only the owner/operator may change a status. The procedure is: (1) owner records the new explicit decision in the platform tripwire review entry where one exists (tiktok-like-recovery.py record-review), (2) owner or operator edits this file's surface status/reason/set_by/set_at, (3) the next scheduled pass runs authority-check.py which re-consumes everything. Workers never write this file and never infer resumption from a cleared banner, timer, or schedule.
